dimensions.assessment: Affects Medicare beneficiaries who undergo mastectomies, particularly older and minority women, as well as medical device suppliers and healthcare providers.
dimensions.evidence: custom fabricated breast prostheses following surgical removal of the breast, including replacement of such prostheses

dimensions.assessment: Provides coverage and reimbursement for a previously denied medical device category under Medicare, changing financial access for post-mastectomy patients.
dimensions.evidence: While the Medicare program recognizes custom fabricated breast prostheses as a discrete device... Medicare does not provide reimbursement and denies claims as 'not medically necessary'.

dimensions.assessment: Implications include increased federal Medicare expenditures for covering custom fabricated breast prostheses and replacements.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this section shall apply to items and services furnished on or after the date of enactment of this Act.

dimensions.assessment: Amends Medicare benefit categories under section 1861(s)(8) and adjusts statutory exclusions under section 1862(a)(7) of the Social Security Act.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1861(s)(8) of the Social Security Act... is amended... by inserting after subparagraph (A) the following new subparagraph: (B) custom fabricated breast prostheses

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change to Medicare coverage rules for all eligible items and services furnished after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this section shall apply to items and services furnished on or after the date of enactment of this Act.

missing_information: CBO score or exact federal expenditure projections for adding Medicare coverage.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends Medicare (Title XVIII of the Social Security Act) to provide coverage and reimbursement for custom fabricated breast prostheses following a mastectomy, addressing prior denials under Medicare.
